-- Every downloaded asset (PDF note or quiz bundle), one row per item. -- 'status' drives the whole DownloadManager state machine. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS downloads ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- content id (note id / quiz id) content_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'note' | 'quiz' title TEXT NOT NULL, chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL, chapter_title TEXT NOT NULL, subject_id TEXT NOT NULL, subject_title TEXT NOT NULL, year_id TEXT NOT NULL, year_title TEXT NOT NULL, source_url TEXT NOT NULL, local_uri TEXT, -- null until status = 'completed' file_size_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0, bytes_written INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- enables resume + progress restore after app kill status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', -- queued|downloading|paused|completed|failed retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, error_message TEXT, content_version INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- bumped server-side when source content changes downloaded_at INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_downloads_status ON downloads(status); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_downloads_chapter ON downloads(chapter_id); -- Outbox pattern: every offline user action queues here first, then -- SyncEngine drains it to Supabase once connectivity returns. This is -- what makes quiz attempts / bookmarks / progress work with zero -- internet and never lose data. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_queue ( queue_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- client-generated UUID (dedupe key) entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'quiz_attempt' | 'bookmark' | 'reading_progress' | 'watch_history' operation TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'upsert' | 'delete' payload TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON blob matching the target Supabase table created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, attempt_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, synced_at INTEGER -- null until confirmed written to server ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_queue_pending ON sync_queue(synced_at); -- Local mirror of quiz attempts so results screen works offline -- immediately; SyncEngine reconciles this with the server copy. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quiz_attempts_local ( attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, quiz_id TEXT NOT NULL, chapter_id TEXT NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL, total_questions INTEGER NOT NULL, answers_json TEXT NOT NULL, taken_at INTEGER NOT NULL, synced INTEGER DEFAULT 0 ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookmarks_local ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, content_type TEXT NOT NULL, content_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0, synced INTEGER DEFAULT 0 ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reading_progress_local ( content_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, content_type TEXT NOT NULL, progress_percent REAL NOT NULL, last_page INTEGER, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, synced INTEGER DEFAULT 0 );
PRAGMA table_info(downloads);
PRAGMA table_info(quiz_attempts_local);
UPDATE downloads SET status = 'paused' WHERE status = 'downloading';

SELECT * FROM sync_queue WHERE synced_at IS NULL AND (entity_type <> 'quiz_attempt' OR NOT json_valid(payload) OR json_extract(payload, '$.user_id') IS NULL OR json_extract(payload, '$.user_id') = ?) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 50;
